messages:
ivy: kicking off a config-only rollout to tighten routing weight_floor and slim tiny_batch. change window 14:00-14:20 PT. plan: staged cohorts + manual pin for paid-critical tenants. notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/rc-2026-03-21-c

mano: what keys?

ivy: short list:
- routing.weight_floor 0.03 -> 0.06
- tiny_batch.max_tokens 40 -> 26
- request.timeout_ms 18000 -> 13000
- prefer_local_region for tenant.tag 'eu-regional' only
(no model changes)

diego: recommend cohorts A=internal, B=low-traffic, C=paid-critical (manual). 2m observe each.

ops-ryan: deploy-bot queue and annotate canary. Dash: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/routing/rc-2026-03-21-c Alerts: 95p +20% or 5xx +0.5% or avg batch drop >30% -> hold.

deploy-bot: queued config rc-2026-03-21-c -> prod. canary cohort A at 1720001111. rollback window until 1720001411. Use /deploy abort to stop.

ivy: cohort A starting (internal) at 1% traffic. monitoring. ping on any 5xx or latency uptick.

mano: initial metrics look fine. batch size down ~9%. no 5xx.

deploy-bot: promoting to cohort B -> 12% traffic.

diego: moving to manual approval for cohort C.

ivy: approving manual step. cohort C start 14:06 PT at 30% then ramp to 100% over 6m if stable.

ops-ryan: watchlist set for top paid tenants. rollback playbook: /deploy abort, pin tenant to rc-2026-03-14, escalate if >1% 5xx for 3m.

deploy-bot: cohort C at 30% - monitoring.

ivy: seeing a short 502 burst for t-321. temporarily pinning t-321 back to previous routing weight_floor and routing to fallback pool.

deploy-bot: manual pin applied for t-321 -> pinned to rc-2026-03-14. traffic split updated.

mano: t-321 errors dropped after pin. good to continue for others, keep t-321 pinned and file follow-up.

ivy: rollout finished: ~98% tenants updated, 1% pinned (t-321), 1% staged/paused. filing postmortem and scheduling integration test with tightened timeout for t-321. thanks team!
